about: Brockton is a municipality in Bruce County, Ontario, centred on Walkerton along the Saugeen River—not a city, and not Brockton in other countries. Farmland, the county seat at Walkerton, and hamlets such as Cargill, Chepstow, and Elmwood define this inland Bruce County community. About 10,000 people live in Brockton.
